latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of economic-incentive-misalignment-detector:

- Provides analysis to detect when marketplace incentives push for quantity over safety and quality.
- Examines structural risk factors, including publisher concentration, publication velocity vs. review capacity, revenue model conflicts, investment ratios, and enforcement consistency.
- Delivers comprehensive incentive alignment reports highlighting systemic misalignments even when individual code is technically sound.
- Helps users and marketplaces understand root causes of quality degradation beyond what technical audits can reveal.
